Hi Marcus,

Thanks for the demo last week — the product looked good and the team is aligned on capabilities. Procurement asked me to surface a mutual action plan (MAP) and a clear billing / acceptance path for an AWS Private Offer so we can get internal approvals.

Can you send a short MAP showing:
- evaluation & PoC milestones we should expect
- security / evidence we should provide for SOC2/arch review
- procurement steps and expected timelines for an AWS Private Offer (and any alternative billing/invoicing flows)
- the artifacts we’ll need to accept (SOW/PO/contract) and how signature will be handled (DocuSign vs. AWS acceptance)

We’re targeting a mid-November go/no-go but need a clear 3–4 week procurement path to make that.

Appreciate a one-page plan + any templates you can attach.

Thanks,

Elena — thanks for the note and the clear ask. I’ve assembled a short MAP and attached a draft SOW. High level summary below; see attached MAP_Novacorp_AWS_v1.xlsx for a week-by-week view.

Short MAP (proposed):
- Week 0 (today): Kickoff + share MAP & SOW (attached). HubSpot deal linked below.
- Week 1 (Nov 3–9): Evaluation / PoC run (test workload in an isolated tenant). Our solutions engineer will provide test prompts, perf baseline, and a 1-hr review session.
- Week 2 (Nov 10–16): Security & architecture review. We’ll provide SOC 2 summary, network diagrams, and an audit log sample. Expect 3–5 business days for typical review.
- Week 3 (Nov 17–23): Commercial approvals & AWS Private Offer creation. Once legal signs SOW/Order Form, we submit the Private Offer to AWS (3–5 business days for AWS acceptance historically).
- Week 4 (Nov 24–30): Final acceptance and handoff to Delivery; start of billing.

Billing / procurement options (recommended):
1) AWS Private Offer via Marketplace (recommended) — Customer accepts the Private Offer in Marketplace; billing flows through AWS to Novacorp’s normal AP processes. Pros: integrates with existing AP, easy acceptance. Cons: requires Marketplace account setup.
2) Direct invoice (Net 30) — Redwood issues a monthly invoice once PO is in place. Pros: familiar to vendors; Cons: extra AR work for Novacorp.

Recommended path: Private Offer + DocuSign-signed SOW for contractual terms. We can also provide an invoicing fallback if your AP needs it.

Action items / owners:
- Marcus (me): Provide MAP + SOW, submit Private Offer to AWS once Legal signs.
- Monica Patel (cc): Finalize pricing band and draft Order Form.
- Ben Carter (cc): Configure billing flow and provide Marketplace acceptance steps + AWS account IDs to use.
- Elena / Procurement: Confirm PO window, acceptance owner, and target date for DocuSign signature.

Attachments: MAP_Novacorp_AWS_v1.xlsx (mutual action plan, milestones)
Novacorp_SOW_v0.3.pdf (draft SOW)

Links: HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/45812
DocuSign (placeholder): https://www.docusign.com/placeholder/novacorp-offer-45812

If the above works I can schedule a 30-min kickoff for Wed Nov 4 to align the PoC scope and calendar.

Cheers,
Marcus Lin
Sales Director | Redwood Inference
